description: This file defines an abstract base class 'VisitorBase' for implementing the visitor pattern in the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for flattening and processing various document elements such as paragraph formats, borders, shading, page setup, charts, tables, and sections, facilitating document rendering or transformation.

classes.name: VisitorBase
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the visitor pattern for traversing and processing document object model elements in MigraDoc.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Overrides the base method to visit a DocumentObject and accept the visitor if visitable.

methods.name: FlattenParagraphFormat
methods.description: Merges properties from a reference ParagraphFormat into another, filling in null or empty values.

methods.name: FlattenListInfo
methods.description: Merges list information properties from a reference ListInfo into another.

methods.name: FlattenFont
methods.description: Copies font properties from a reference Font into another, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: FlattenShading
methods.description: Copies shading properties from a reference Shading into another.

methods.name: FlattenedBorderFromBorders
methods.description: Creates or updates a Border object based on parent Borders, copying style properties.

methods.name: FlattenBorders
methods.description: Merges border properties from a reference Borders object into another.

methods.name: FlattenBorder
methods.description: Copies border style properties from a reference Border into another.

methods.name: FlattenTabStops
methods.description: Merges tab stop collections, adding missing tabs and preventing inheritance.

methods.name: FlattenPageSetup
methods.description: Merges page setup properties from a reference PageSetup into another, adjusting orientation and size.

methods.name: RealizeOrientation
methods.description: Adjusts PageSetup orientation based on page width and height, swapping values if necessary.

methods.name: UpdateOrientation
methods.description: Sets PageSetup orientation based on page width and height.

methods.name: FlattenHeaderFooter
methods.description: Placeholder method for flattening header/footer elements.

methods.name: FlattenFillFormat
methods.description: Placeholder method for flattening fill formatting.

methods.name: FlattenLineFormat
methods.description: Copies line format width from a reference to another.

methods.name: FlattenAxis
methods.description: Processes axis gridlines and line formats for charts.

methods.name: FlattenPlotArea
methods.description: Placeholder for processing plot area elements.

methods.name: FlattenDataLabel
methods.description: Placeholder for processing data labels.

methods.name: VisitChart
methods.description: Processes a Chart element, flattening styles, axes, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: VisitDocument
methods.description: Empty override for visiting a Document.

methods.name: VisitDocumentElements
methods.description: Empty override for visiting document elements.

methods.name: VisitStyle
methods.description: Processes a Style, flattening its paragraph format based on its base style.

methods.name: VisitStyles
methods.description: Empty override for visiting styles collection.

methods.name: VisitFootnote
methods.description: Processes a Footnote, setting its paragraph format based on style.

methods.name: VisitParagraph
methods.description: Processes a Paragraph, determining its style and format based on context.

methods.name: VisitHeaderFooter
methods.description: Processes header/footer elements, setting paragraph formats.

methods.name: VisitHeadersFooters
methods.description: Empty override for headers/footers collection.

methods.name: VisitSection
methods.description: Processes a Section, inheriting page setup and header/footer info from previous sections.

methods.name: VisitSections
methods.description: Empty override for sections collection.

methods.name: VisitTextFrame
methods.description: Sets default size for TextFrame if not specified.

methods.name: VisitCell
methods.description: Placeholder for processing a table cell.

methods.name: VisitColumns
methods.description: Sets column widths if not specified.

methods.name: VisitRow
methods.description: Sets cell vertical alignment based on row.

methods.name: VisitRows
methods.description: Sets row height, height rule, and vertical alignment.

methods.name: ParagraphFormatFromStyle
methods.description: Creates a ParagraphFormat from a style, cloning and flattening as needed.

methods.name: VisitTable
methods.description: Processes a Table, setting paddings, styles, and formatting for columns, rows, and cells.

methods.name: VisitLegend
methods.description: Sets legend paragraph format based on style or parent TextArea.

methods.name: VisitTextArea
methods.description: Sets paragraph format, fill, and line formats for TextArea elements.

methods.name: GetDocumentElementHolder
methods.description: Retrieves the parent DocumentObject of a DocumentObject.
